{{#seo:|title=Help:Saintapedia Graph}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Help:Saintapedia Graph}} {{Saintapedia Graph examples}} '''Saintapedia Graph''' turns [[mw:Extension:Cargo|Cargo]] tables into interactive [https://mermaid.js.org/ Mermaid] flowcharts. Typical uses on this wiki are '''organization charts''' (who reports to whom) and '''funding networks''' (who funded whom). Any parent/child or source/target relationship stored in Cargo can be drawn the same way. {{note|This page documents '''Saintapedia Graph 0.2.5'''. Parser-function errors and warnings are '''English only'''; other interface languages still show English for those messages.}} __TOC__ == What you need == * This extension (Saintapedia Graph) * [[mw:Extension:Cargo|Extension:Cargo]] — data comes from Cargo tables, not from wikitext lists * MediaWiki 1.39+ / PHP 8.1+ '''You do ''not'' need Extension:Mermaid.''' Saintapedia Graph ships Mermaid 10.9.1 and renders diagrams itself. Editors write a parser function (or a wrapper template). The extension runs one or two Cargo queries, builds a flowchart, and the browser draws it. == Quick start == === 1. Have Cargo tables === Any parent/child or source/target Cargo table works — dioceses, parishes, religious orders, foundations, not only a table named Organizations. The bundled sample (import with --examples) uses '''OrgDemo''' / '''GrantDemo''' so it will not overwrite a wiki's Organization or Grant templates: 
{{#cargo_declare:_table=OrgDemo
|Name=String
|ParentOrg=Page
|Type=String
|Country=String
|Website=URL
}}

{{#cargo_declare:_table=GrantDemo
|Funder=Page
|Recipient=Page
|Amount=Float
|Year=Integer
|Program=String
}}
On a live diocese wiki, declare your own tables (for example Parishes with a Page-type Diocese column) and pass table=Parishes / parent=Diocese to [[Template:Org chart]]. Store rows with #cargo_store (usually from an infobox template). Create or recreate tables at [[Special:CargoTables]] if they are missing. Use '''Page'''-type fields for parents, funders, and recipients so node clicks open the right wiki page. === 2. Org chart === 
{{#saintapedia_graph:
tables=OrgDemo
|fields=_pageName=Name,ParentOrg,Type,Country
|parent_field=ParentOrg
|node_id=Name
|style_by=Type
|subgraph_by=Country
|direction=TD
|clickable=yes
}}
Edges are '''parent → child''' (archdiocese → diocese → parish, or any reporting line). Shorter: {{Org chart|table=OrgDemo|style=Type|subgraph=Country}} Real parishes: {{Org chart|table=Parishes|parent=Diocese|id=_pageName}} === 3. Funding network === Prefer '''dual-table''' mode when organizations live in one table and grants in another (colors and groups then come from the organization row, not the grant row): 
{{#saintapedia_graph:
nodes_table=OrgDemo
|nodes_fields=_pageName=Name,Type,Country
|edges_table=GrantDemo
|edges_fields=Funder,Recipient,Amount
|edges_where=Year>=2023
|node_id=_pageName
|node_label=Name
|source_field=Funder
|target_field=Recipient
|edge_label=Amount
|style_by=Type
|subgraph_by=Country
|direction=LR
|theme=forest
}}
Shorter: {{Funding network|nodes=OrgDemo|edges=GrantDemo|style=Type|subgraph=Country|edges_where=Year>=2023}} If you only have one table of links, use '''edge''' mode (one query): 
{{#saintapedia_graph:
tables=Grants
|fields=Funder,Recipient,Amount,Year
|source_field=Funder
|target_field=Recipient
|edge_label=Amount
|direction=LR
|theme=forest
}}
=== Live examples === Each example is a '''Help:''' subpage with the wikitext and (when OrgDemo / GrantDemo are imported) the live graph on the same page. Start at [[Help:Saintapedia Graph/Examples]]. == How to pick a mode == Each diagram is exactly '''one''' mode. Mixing parent_field with source_field/target_field is an error. Dual mode is chosen when you set nodes_table and edges_table. {| class="wikitable" ! Mode ! When to use ! Required ! Edge direction ! Cargo queries |- | '''Hierarchy''' | Org charts, subsidiaries, “reports to” | tables= + parent_field= | Parent → child | 1 |- | '''Edge''' | Links stored in one table (grant rows, ownership rows) | tables= + source_field= + target_field= | Source → target | 1 |- | '''Dual-table''' | Nodes in one table, edges in another (typical funding network) | nodes_table= + edges_table= + source/target fields | Source → target | '''2''' (counts as two expensive parser functions) |} === Hierarchy details === * Each Cargo row is one child node. * parent_field names the parent. Empty parent = a root. * If the parent is not itself a row, the extension still draws it (label = the parent value). * A synthetic parent can inherit a subgraph box from its first child. === Edge details === * Each row is one arrow from source_field to target_field. * Missing source or target cells are skipped. * If you set style_by / subgraph_by in this mode, those values come from the '''same row as the edge''' and are applied to the source node (the target only inherits the subgraph). === Dual-table details === * First query loads nodes (labels, click targets, colors, groups). * Second query loads edges. Endpoints that are not in the node query are still drawn (plain label, no style). * Styles are '''not''' overwritten by the edge query. * Both queries use the same limit= (see [[#Limits|Limits]]). ==== Matching nodes to edges ==== Grant Funder / Recipient fields are usually '''page titles'''. Set: 
|node_id=_pageName
|node_label=Name
so “Ford Foundation” on a grant matches the organization page. If you set node_id=Name, the Name cell must be identical to the page title. == Parser functions == Primary: {{#saintapedia_graph: … }} Alias: {{#cargo_mermaid: … }} (same parameters) Parameter names are case-insensitive. Spaces and hyphens become underscores (join on = join_on, nodes-table = nodes_table). === Cargo query (hierarchy and edge) === Same idea as #cargo_query. {| class="wikitable" ! Parameter ! Description |- | tables / table | Required. One or more Cargo tables, comma-separated. |- | fields | Columns to select. The extension adds any extra columns it still needs (parent_field, style_by, …). |- | where | Filter (Cargo/SQL-style). |- | join on | Join conditions. Required when tables= lists more than one table. |- | group by / having | Aggregation (Cargo rules). |- | order by | Sort. |- | limit | Max rows '''per Cargo query'''. See [[#Limits|Limits]]. |- | offset | Skip initial rows (single-query modes). Dual-mode edge query always starts at offset 0. |} === Dual-table query === {| class="wikitable" ! Parameter ! Description |- | nodes_table / edges_table | Required together. |- | nodes_fields / edges_fields | Columns for each query. Empty edges_fields defaults to source, target, and optional edge label. |- | nodes_where / edges_where | Per-query filters. |- | nodes_join_on / edges_join_on | Per-query joins. |- | nodes_order_by / edges_order_by | Per-query sort. |} === Diagram === {| class="wikitable" ! Parameter ! Default ! Description |- | direction | site default, usually TD | TD (top-down; TB is accepted as the same), LR, BT, RL |- | node_id | _pageName | Field that uniquely identifies a node |- | node_label | same as node_id (dual mode may pick Name if that column is in nodes_fields) | Text on the node |- | page_field | hierarchy/dual: _pageName; edge: the endpoint value itself | Wiki title used for the click link |- | parent_field | — | Hierarchy only |- | source_field / target_field | — | Edge and dual (both required) |- | edge_label | — | Optional caption on the arrow (truncated around 64 characters) |- | style_by | — | Color nodes by this column (must exist) |- | subgraph_by | — | Group nodes in a box by this column (must exist) |- | link_style | --> | -->, -.->, ==>, ---, <--> (anything else becomes -->) |- | clickable | site default, usually yes | yes/no (also true/false, 1/0, on/off) |- | theme | site default, usually default | default, base, dark, forest, neutral. Unknown values fall back to default and warn. |- | warn_cycles | site default, usually yes | Warn when the directed graph contains a cycle |- | break_cycles | site default, usually no | Drop edges that close cycles (keeps a DAG-like picture) |- | format | mermaid | mermaid = draw; raw / source / text = print Mermaid source |} == Templates == Imported by the [[#Installing the help page|maintenance script]] (or by hand from templates/). === {{Org chart}} === Hierarchy. Default table is Organizations; pass table=OrgDemo for the sample or table=Parishes for a real diocese wiki. {| class="wikitable" ! Argument ! Default ! Maps to |- | table | Organizations | tables= |- | parent | ParentOrg | parent_field= |- | id | Name | node_id= |- | label | same as id | node_label= |- | style | — | style_by= (real column) |- | subgraph | — | subgraph_by= (real column) |- | where | — | where= |- | order | the id field | order by= |- | direction | TD | direction= |- | limit | 200 | limit= |- | clickable | yes | clickable= |- | theme | default | theme= |- | warn_cycles / break_cycles | yes / no | same |} === {{Funding network}} === Dual-table nodes + edges. Defaults are Organizations / Grants; pass nodes=OrgDemo and edges=GrantDemo for the sample. {| class="wikitable" ! Argument ! Default ! Maps to |- | nodes / edges | Organizations / Grants | nodes_table= / edges_table= |- | source / target | Funder / Recipient | source_field= / target_field= |- | id | _pageName | node_id= |- | label | Name | node_label= |- | page | _pageName | page_field= |- | edge_label | Amount | edge_label= |- | style / subgraph | — | node-table columns |- | edges_where or where | — | edges_where= |- | nodes_where | — | nodes_where= |- | direction | LR | direction= |- | theme | forest | theme= |- | limit | 300 | limit= (both queries) |- | clickable, warn_cycles, break_cycles | yes / yes / no | same |} == Colors, groups, and themes == * style_by assigns a fill from the site palette (ten colors by default) to each distinct value. * subgraph_by draws a labeled box around nodes that share a value (country, program, …). * theme= is a Mermaid built-in: default, base, dark, forest, neutral. Typos such as forset still render (theme default) and show a warning. == Clicks == With clickable=yes, a node opens the wiki page from page_field (or the node id). Links are '''same-origin paths only''' (/wiki/… or index.php?…). Absolute and protocol-relative URLs are dropped. JavaScript is required for the interactive SVG. Without JS you get a <noscript> copy of the Mermaid source. == Limits == limit= is '''per Cargo query''': * Default when omitted: $wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultLimit (usually 500). * Hard cap: $wgSaintapediaGraphMaxLimit (usually 1000). * Values below 1 (including negatives) become 1. * If the requested number is rewritten, a warning appears: limit $1 reduced to $2; the graph may be missing rows. * Dual mode runs '''two''' queries at that same cap, so a page can fetch up to 2× the max (nodes + edges). Dual mode also prints a second warning line that each query is capped. Each diagram counts as one '''expensive''' parser function; dual mode counts as two. Too many on one page hits $wgExpensiveParserFunctionLimit. == Cycles == Directed loops (A→B→A, or longer) are detected after the graph is built. * warn_cycles=yes (default) prints how many cycles were found. * break_cycles=yes drops the back-edges that close those cycles, then optionally reports how many edges were removed. The cycle count can overlap on dense graphs; treat it as a signal, not a precise census. Path labels still use internal node ids, not display names. == One query with several tables vs dual mode == These are different: # tables=Grants,Organizations + join on=… — '''one''' result set. In edge mode each row is an edge; node names come from source/target. A join can enrich filters or labels but does not give each node its own Type/Country unless those columns are on the row. # nodes_table + edges_table — '''two''' queries. Use this when styles/groups live on the organization table. Single-query join example: 
{{#saintapedia_graph:
tables=Grants,Organizations
|join on=Grants.Funder=Organizations._pageName
|fields=Grants.Funder,Grants.Recipient,Grants.Amount,Organizations.Type
|source_field=Funder
|target_field=Recipient
|edge_label=Amount
|direction=LR
|limit=300
}}
Not in this version: expand “everyone within N steps of X”, Sankey, hover field tooltips, or SVG/PNG export. == Debugging == * format=raw — print the generated Mermaid instead of drawing. * After an extension update, hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) so the browser is not holding an old ResourceLoader module. * Warnings render in a yellow box above the diagram; errors in a red box. Both are English. == Troubleshooting == {| class="wikitable" ! Symptom ! What to try |- | “tables parameter is required” | Set tables=, or both nodes_table and edges_table |- | Missing mode / mixed modes | Hierarchy '''or''' edge '''or''' dual — not parent plus source/target |- | Dual mode missing a table | Both node and edge tables are required |- | No results | [[Special:CargoTables]]; re-save pages that #cargo_store |- | Nodes and edges do not match | Dual mode: node_id=_pageName so endpoints equal page titles |- | Unknown theme warning | Use default, base, dark, forest, or neutral |- | Limit reduced warning | Requested limit= was rewritten (over the site max, or below 1) |- | Cycle warning | The directed graph loops. break_cycles=yes drops back-edges |- | “Diagram failed to render” | Hard-refresh; format=raw; browser console |- | Too many expensive parser functions | Fewer graphs per page (dual = two), or raise $wgExpensiveParserFunctionLimit |- | Cargo join error | Every table in tables= must appear in join on= |- | Clicks do nothing | Need JS; clickable=yes; page title must exist; only local paths are emitted |- | Diagram unstyled | Site CSP may block Mermaid’s inline SVG styles — ask an admin (see README) |} == Installing the help page == === Special:Import (no shell) === Download an XML dump from GitHub and import it at [[Special:Import]] (sysop / import right): * [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Saintapedia/SaintapediaGraph/main/docs/import/SaintapediaGraph-help.xml SaintapediaGraph-help.xml] — this Help page, [[Template:Org chart]], [[Template:Funding network]], [[Template:Saintapedia Graph examples]] * [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Saintapedia/SaintapediaGraph/main/docs/import/SaintapediaGraph-examples.xml SaintapediaGraph-examples.xml] — help '''plus''' OrgDemo / GrantDemo, the Demo … pages, and the [[Help:Saintapedia Graph/Examples|example series]] Save the file, then Special:Import → upload. Assign the edits to your account. After the examples dump, recreate Cargo: 
php extensions/Cargo/maintenance/cargoRecreateData.php --table OrgDemo
php extensions/Cargo/maintenance/cargoRecreateData.php --table GrantDemo
=== Maintenance script === Admins (from the wiki root): 
php maintenance/run.php SaintapediaGraph:importPages
MediaWiki 1.39: 
php extensions/SaintapediaGraph/maintenance/importPages.php
--dry-run lists create/update/skip. --overwrite replaces existing Help and templates. --examples also imports OrgDemo / GrantDemo and the [[Help:Saintapedia Graph/Examples|Help: example series]] (does '''not''' create Organization or Grant templates). That writes: * [[Help:Saintapedia Graph]] (this page) * [[Template:Org chart]] * [[Template:Funding network]] * [[Template:Saintapedia Graph examples]] (right-hand series table) With --examples, also [[Template:OrgDemo]], [[Template:GrantDemo]], the Demo … diocese/parish pages, GrantDemo: rows, and the demo page. Then recreate Cargo if needed: 
php extensions/Cargo/maintenance/cargoRecreateData.php --table OrgDemo
php extensions/Cargo/maintenance/cargoRecreateData.php --table GrantDemo
The public mediawiki.org listing is a separate paste file in the repo (docs/mediawiki.org-Extension-SaintapediaGraph.wikitext); it is not imported here. == Configuration (admins) == LocalSettings.php / Canasta (after Cargo): 
wfLoadExtension( 'Cargo' );
wfLoadExtension( 'SaintapediaGraph' );

$wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultDirection = 'TD';
$wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultLimit = 500;
$wgSaintapediaGraphMaxLimit = 1000;
$wgSaintapediaGraphClickable = true;
$wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultTheme = 'default';
$wgSaintapediaGraphUseStandaloneRenderer = true;
$wgSaintapediaGraphWarnCycles = true;
$wgSaintapediaGraphBreakCycles = false;
{| class="wikitable" ! Variable ! Default ! Meaning |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultDirection | TD | Layout when direction= is omitted |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultLimit | 500 | Default rows per Cargo query |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphMaxLimit | 1000 | Hard cap '''per query''' (dual mode can fetch 2×) |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphClickable | true | Default for clickable= |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphDefaultTheme | default | Default Mermaid theme |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphUseStandaloneRenderer | true | false prints source only (no JS) |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphWarnCycles | true | Default for warn_cycles= |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphBreakCycles | false | Default for break_cycles= |- | $wgSaintapediaGraphStylePalette | 10 hex colors | Fills for style_by |} The folder name on disk must be extensions/SaintapediaGraph (ResourceLoader path). No update.php run is required. Scripts are same-origin ResourceLoader (bundled Mermaid). No CDN. UI strings are English-only. CSP notes are in the extension README on GitHub. == Related pages == * [[Help:Saintapedia Graph/Examples]] — one Help page per use (code + live graph) * [[Saintapedia Graph smoke]] — warning cases (local QA) * [[Special:CargoTables]] — declare / recreate Cargo tables * [[mw:Extension:Cargo|Cargo documentation]] * [[mw:Extension:SaintapediaGraph|Extension:SaintapediaGraph]] on mediawiki.org * [https://github.com/Saintapedia/SaintapediaGraph SaintapediaGraph on GitHub] [[Category:Help]] [[Category:Cargo]] [[Category:Saintapedia Graph]]

'''Template:Org chart''' — wrapper for [[Help:Saintapedia Graph]] hierarchy diagrams. style / subgraph must be real Cargo columns (e.g. Type, Country). Pass table= for Parishes, OrgDemo, or any parent/child table. 
{{Org chart
|table=OrgDemo
|parent=ParentOrg
|id=Name
|label=Name
|style=Type
|subgraph=Country
|where=
|direction=TD
|limit=200
}}
[[Category:Saintapedia Graph templates]] {{#saintapedia_graph: tables={{{table|Organizations}}} |fields=_pageName={{{id|Name}}},{{{parent|ParentOrg}}}{{#if:{{{style|}}}|,{{{style}}}}}{{#if:{{{subgraph|}}}|,{{{subgraph}}}}} |where={{{where|}}} |order by={{{order|{{{id|Name}}}}}} |limit={{{limit|200}}} |direction={{{direction|TD}}} |node_id={{{id|Name}}} |node_label={{{label|{{{id|Name}}}}}} |parent_field={{{parent|ParentOrg}}} |style_by={{{style|}}} |subgraph_by={{{subgraph|}}} |clickable={{{clickable|yes}}} |theme={{{theme|default}}} |warn_cycles={{{warn_cycles|yes}}} |break_cycles={{{break_cycles|no}}} }}

'''Template:Funding network''' — dual-table funding diagram for [[Help:Saintapedia Graph]] (nodes from one table, edges from another). Defaults are Organizations / Grants; the bundled sample uses OrgDemo / GrantDemo. Uses node_id=_pageName by default so Funder/Recipient page titles match. style / subgraph must be real Cargo columns on the nodes table. 
{{Funding network
|nodes=OrgDemo
|edges=GrantDemo
|style=Type
|subgraph=Country
|source=Funder
|target=Recipient
|edge_label=Amount
|edges_where=Year>=2023
|direction=LR
|theme=forest
|limit=300
}}
[[Category:Saintapedia Graph templates]] {{#saintapedia_graph: nodes_table={{{nodes|Organizations}}} |nodes_fields=_pageName,Name{{#if:{{{style|}}}|,{{{style}}}}}{{#if:{{{subgraph|}}}|,{{{subgraph}}}}} |nodes_where={{{nodes_where|}}} |edges_table={{{edges|Grants}}} |edges_fields={{{source|Funder}}},{{{target|Recipient}}}{{#if:{{{edge_label|Amount}}}|,{{{edge_label|Amount}}}}} |edges_where={{{edges_where|{{{where|}}}}}} |node_id={{{id|_pageName}}} |node_label={{{label|Name}}} |page_field={{{page|_pageName}}} |source_field={{{source|Funder}}} |target_field={{{target|Recipient}}} |edge_label={{{edge_label|Amount}}} |style_by={{{style|}}} |subgraph_by={{{subgraph|}}} |direction={{{direction|LR}}} |limit={{{limit|300}}} |clickable={{{clickable|yes}}} |theme={{{theme|forest}}} |warn_cycles={{{warn_cycles|yes}}} |break_cycles={{{break_cycles|no}}} }}
